#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page to report.pdf with title and current date."""
import datetime
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"
TODAY = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
COVER = "cover.pdf"
OUTPUT = "report_with_cover.pdf"

# 1) Build the cover page
width, height = letter
c = canvas.Canvas(COVER, pagesize=letter)
c.setFont("Times-Roman", 40)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height * 0.62, TITLE)
c.setFont("Times-Roman", 18)
c.drawCentredString(width / 2, height * 0.55, TODAY)
c.save()

# 2) Prepend the cover to the existing report
writer = PdfWriter()
writer.add_page(PdfReader(COVER).pages[0])
reader = PdfReader("report.pdf")
for page in reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)
with open(OUTPUT, "wb") as fh:
    writer.write(fh)

# 3) Verify the result
check = PdfReader(OUTPUT)
print("output_file:", OUTPUT)
print("page_count:", len(check.pages))
first_text = check.pages[0].extract_text() or ""
print("cover_text:", repr(first_text))
print("title_present:", TITLE in first_text)
print("date_present:", TODAY in first_text)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page to report.pdf with title and current date.

Uses only pypdf (already installed) plus a hand-built minimal PDF for the
cover page, since reportlab is not available in this environment.
"""
import datetime
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"
TODAY = datetime.date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
COVER = "cover.pdf"
OUTPUT = "report_with_cover.pdf"
PAGE_W, PAGE_H = 612, 792  # US Letter

# Helvetica AFM widths (per 1000 units of em)
WIDTHS = {
    " ": 278, "!": 278, '"': 355, "#": 556, "$": 556, "%": 889, "&": 667,
    "'": 191, "(": 333, ")": 333, "*": 389, "+": 584, ",": 278, "-": 333,
    ".": 278, "/": 278, "0": 556, "1": 556, "2": 556, "3": 556, "4": 556,
    "5": 556, "6": 556, "7": 556, "8": 556, "9": 556, ":": 278, ";": 278,
    "<": 584, "=": 584, ">": 584, "?": 556, "@": 1015, "A": 667, "B": 667,
    "C": 722, "D": 722, "E": 667, "F": 611, "G": 778, "H": 722, "I": 278,
    "J": 500, "K": 667, "L": 556, "M": 833, "N": 722, "O": 778, "P": 667,
    "Q": 778, "R": 722, "S": 667, "T": 611, "U": 722, "V": 667, "W": 944,
    "X": 667, "Y": 667, "Z": 611, "[": 278, "\\": 278, "]": 278, "^": 469,
    "_": 556, "`": 333, "a": 556, "b": 556, "c": 500, "d": 556, "e": 556,
    "f": 278, "g": 556, "h": 556, "i": 222, "j": 222, "k": 500, "l": 222,
    "m": 833, "n": 556, "o": 556, "p": 556, "q": 556, "r": 333, "s": 500,
    "t": 278, "u": 556, "v": 500, "w": 722, "x": 500, "y": 500, "z": 500,
    "{": 334, "|": 260, "}": 334, "~": 584,
}


def esc(s):
    return s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")


def text_width(s, size):
    return sum(WIDTHS.get(ch, 556) for ch in s) * size / 1000.0


def build_cover_pdf(path):
    title_size, date_size = 40, 18
    title_x = (PAGE_W - text_width(TITLE, title_size)) / 2.0
    title_y = PAGE_H * 0.62
    date_x = (PAGE_W - text_width(TODAY, date_size)) / 2.0
    date_y = PAGE_H * 0.55

    content = (
        "BT\n"
        f"/F1 {title_size} Tf\n"
        f"{title_x:.2f} {title_y:.2f} Td\n"
        f"({esc(TITLE)}) Tj\n"
        "ET\n"
        "BT\n"
        f"/F1 {date_size} Tf\n"
        f"{date_x:.2f} {date_y:.2f} Td\n"
        f"({esc(TODAY)}) Tj\n"
        "ET\n"
    ).encode("latin-1")

    objects = [
        b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>",
        b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>",
        (b"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] "
         b"/Resources << /Font << /F1 4 0 R >> >> /Contents 5 0 R >>"),
        b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>",
        b"<< /Length %d >>\nstream\n" % len(content) + content + b"\nendstream",
    ]

    pdf = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n")
    offsets = []
    for i, obj in enumerate(objects, 1):
        offsets.append(len(pdf))
        pdf += b"%d 0 obj\n" % i
        pdf += obj
        pdf += b"\nendobj\n"
    xref_pos = len(pdf)
    pdf += b"xref\n0 %d\n" % (len(objects) + 1)
    pdf += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for off in offsets:
        pdf += b"%010d 00000 n \n" % off
    pdf += (b"trailer\n<< /Size %d /Root 1 0 R >>\nstartxref\n%d\n%%%%EOF\n"
            % (len(objects) + 1, xref_pos))
    with open(path, "wb") as fh:
        fh.write(pdf)


build_cover_pdf(COVER)

# Prepend the cover to the existing report
writer = PdfWriter()
writer.add_page(PdfReader(COVER).pages[0])
reader = PdfReader("report.pdf")
for page in reader.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)
with open(OUTPUT, "wb") as fh:
    writer.write(fh)

# Verify the result
check = PdfReader(OUTPUT)
print("output_file:", OUTPUT)
print("page_count:", len(check.pages))
first_text = check.pages[0].extract_text() or ""
print("cover_text:", repr(first_text))
print("title_present:", TITLE in first_text)
print("date_present:", TODAY in first_text)
